transcript: Let the past stay in the past, because no one in this world can change what has already happened, but everyone can change what they do with the moment they have now. We hold on to the past as if it's still alive, as if thinking about it one more time will rewrite it. But the past isn't a collection of doors you can reopen, it's a story already written. The mistakes, the heartbreaks, the words left unsaid, they live there, not here. And as long as you keep carrying it with you, it becomes a weight on the soul, a weight you were never meant to hold. There comes a moment when you must realize what happened doesn't define you, it only taught you. What ended isn't missing, it simply made space for something new. And what you cannot change should not continue changing you. The moment you stop fighting what has already happened, the heart softens, the breath deepens, and the future stops being frightening. It becomes open. Let the past rest in the only place it belongs, behind you, and choose to meet yourself in the only place your power exists, here, now. Reading wisdom is comforting, living it is what changes your life. If you are ready to stop carrying yesterday into today, join my 30-day healing journey, a simple daily path to calm the mind, soften the heart, and rebuild inner strength. Link in my bio. Start where your power lives, now.
